ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 27
   C. 25
   D. 31

2. Solve for x: x + 6 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 8

3. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 10

4. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 50

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144

6. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 72
   C. 17
   D. 1

   A. 400

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)

   D. 121

13. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

14. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42

15. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 9

16. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 41
   C. 3
   D. 13

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

2. Substitute values: c² = 7² + 24²

5. c = 25
Final Answer: 25 cm
